prerequisites: Introduction to the Finite Element Method

learning_outcomes.text: Understand and analyze various damage mechanisms in their future profession and implement them in finite element analysis software.
To understand damage mechanisms and their consequences.
To acquire the ability to model damage in nonlinear mechanics.
To develop proficiency in numerically integrating damage models into structural analysis software.

syllabus_topics: Damage processes: microscopic phenomena and macroscopic mechanical manifestations (property degradation, induced anisotropy, unilateral effect)
Mechanics of damage: objectives, scale of study, general principles
Description of damage: microscopic (counting, defect density function) and macroscopic approaches (physical properties, mechanical properties, notion of effective stress)
Modeling approach: thermodynamics of irreversible processes, state variables
Modeling approach: thermodynamic potential, evolution law, numerical aspects
Example of an isotropic damage model
Development of an analytical model of brittle damage
Study of a brittle damage application using finite element software
Study of a ductile damage application using finite element software
